subject: Co-host invite: Scaling LLM inference — StreamLytics mini-lab (Nov 11)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@streamlytics.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Co-host invite: Scaling LLM inference — StreamLytics mini-lab (Nov 11)

Hi Priya —

Great meeting last week. We chatted about co-hosting a compact, hands-on mini-lab for platform/infra engineers that shows how to run low-latency LLM inference at scale. Wanted to share a concrete proposal and see if StreamLytics wants to take the lead on promotion and registrant outreach.

High-level: 45-minute mini-lab + 15-minute live Q&A (90-minute window for co-host ops). Target audience: infra/platform engineers at Series B+ startups and mid-market SaaS. Goal: show runtime patterns (batching, KV cache, routing) + a short demo of Redwood Dedicated in a VPC.

Proposed dates/times (Pacific):
- Thu Nov 11, 10:00–11:30am PT (preferred)
- Tue Nov 16, 10:00–11:30am PT (backup)

What we need from StreamLytics:
- Promotion to your community (email + Slack + partner blog)
- A StreamLytics host (15 min opening + panel lead)
- Logo + speaker bios by Nov 6

Redwood will provide:
- Speaker(s) and demo environment
- Registration landing page + tracking links
- Post-event recording and a one-pager follow-up pack for attendees

Registration link (trackable): https://redwood.com/events/register?utm_source=streamlytics&utm_campaign=mini-lab-11nov&utm_medium=email

Attached a short one-pager with session bullets and a draft mutual action plan.

[Attachment: webinar-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 240KB)]

If this looks good, can you confirm co-host, preferred date, and the contact for promo? I can put together a short mutual action plan and calendar invites this afternoon.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Manager, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

---

From: Priya Shah <priya@streamlytics.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 11:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Co-host invite: Scaling LLM inference — StreamLytics mini-lab (Nov 11)

Thanks Jonas — this looks promising. We can co-host and Nov 11 works on our side. A couple quick questions before we lock: 

1) Sponsorship / pricing: do you have partner promo credits or a partner fee for co-hosts? We typically offer featured partner placement in our email (top banner) for sponsored events.
2) Compliance: a few of our customers ask about SOC 2 and data retention for demos — can your team provide a short SOC 2 statement or link to security docs we can surface in promotion?
3) Assets: we can get you a logo and two host bios by Nov 6, but would you mind confirming the preferred dimensions and an example speaker photo?

Also looping Kathy on our events team (events@streamlytics.io) — she'll coordinate the promo cadence.

Best,
Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Platform Partnerships | StreamLytics
priya@streamlytics.io

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@streamlytics.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Co-host invite: Scaling LLM inference — StreamLytics mini-lab (Nov 11)

Perfect — thrilled to co-host. Answers inline below and a short mutual action plan (MAP) draft.

1) Sponsorship / pricing: Redwood covers partner promo credits for co-hosts on community events (no partner fee for co-hosts). If StreamLytics wants featured paid placement in our paid newsletter we can discuss a small ad credit — let Ben own that conversation.

2) Compliance: yes — public security page: https://redwood.com/security and SOC 2 summary: https://redwood.com/security/soc2-summary.pdf. For demos we use ephemeral datasets and the demo instance is segregated; Laura will add a one-line security blurb to the registration page.

3) Assets: ideal logo is SVG or 600x200 PNG; headshots 400x400, JPG or PNG. We'll consolidate into a shared Drive folder.

Mutual action plan (draft):
- Today Nov 2: Confirm co-host + preferred date (PR) — both agreed to Nov 11
- Nov 3: Redwood to publish registration landing page + tracking links; StreamLytics to confirm promo dates
- Nov 6: Assets due (logos, bios, headshots) + final copy review
- Nov 9: Dry run and access check for demo env
- Nov 11: Mini-lab live + joint recording distribution

Related links:
- Registration (public): https://redwood.com/events/register?utm_source=streamlytics&utm_campaign=mini-lab-11nov&utm_medium=email
- Shared Asset folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c_assets_for_streamlytics

[Attachment: speaker-bios.zip (ZIP, 2.1MB)]

Ben / Laura — could you two take sponsor/promo logistics and the dry-run scheduling respectively?

Jonas

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@streamlytics.io>, StreamLytics Events <events@streamlytics.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 08:00:00 -0800
Subject: Reminder & registrant ops: mini-lab on Thu Nov 11 — links, snooze ladder, and add-to-calendar

Hi Priya / StreamLytics events team — quick reminder and operational notes as we approach the session on Nov 11. See short checklist and tracking plan below.

Checklist for registrants (we've enabled one-click actions in the registration flow):
- Add to calendar (auto-detect time zone) — registration page includes .ics and Google Calendar deep link
- Choice to "snooze" reminders: 24h / 1h / 15m (we call this the snooze ladder — reduces last-minute dropoff)
- One-click share (Slack/email) for registrants to invite teammates

Tracking & link rotation strategy (to avoid stale UTM caching):
- Primary link (streamlytics top-banner): https://redwood.com/events/register?utm_source=streamlytics&utm_medium=banner&utm_campaign=mini-lab-11nov&link_id=SL-BNR-1
- Secondary link (partner newsletter): https://redwood.com/events/register?utm_source=streamlytics&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=mini-lab-11nov&link_id=SL-NL-1
- Reminder link (direct reminder emails): https://redwood.com/events/register?utm_source=streamlytics&utm_medium=reminder&utm_campaign=mini-lab-11nov&link_id=SL-RMD-1

Snooze ladder note for ops: if a registrant selects "snooze 24h" we target them with a concise 2-line reminder 24h before start and enable a fallback 1h reminder only for snoozed registrants who didn't open 24h message. This reduces noise while preserving attendance.

Assets required (final by Nov 6):
- Sponsor logo (SVG + PNG)
- Two host headshots (400x400, JPG)
- Short speaker blurbs (1–2 lines)

[Attachment: sponsor-logo-guidelines.pdf (PDF, 80KB)]

Ben: can you confirm the partner email cadence (banner + 2 newsletter inserts + 1 reminder)? Laura: can we lock dry-run slot for Nov 9, 10:00am PT?

Thanks all — excited to get this live.

Jonas
Sr. Manager, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
